## Cohort 1 2AFC Analysis
```{r}
## Session 1 vs Session 2 trial-level accuracy: descriptives + GLMM

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)

## 1. Read data
data_path <- "cohort1_afc_by_trial.csv"

df <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    id             = as.factor(as.character(id)),
    session_number = as.factor(as.character(session_number)),
    Trial.Number   = as.numeric(as.character(Trial.Number)),
    score          = as.numeric(as.character(score))
  )

## 2. Descriptive counts-

# IDs per session
n_ids_per_session <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(session_number) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_ids = dplyr::n_distinct(id))

# Trials per ID per session -> mean/SD/min/max per session
trials_per_id_session <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, session_number) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_trials = dplyr::n())

avg_trials_per_session <- trials_per_id_session %>%
  dplyr::group_by(session_number) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_trials = mean(n_trials),
    sd_trials   = sd(n_trials),
    min_trials  = min(n_trials),
    max_trials  = max(n_trials)
  )

# IDs completing BOTH sessions
ids_wide <- df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(id, session_number) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = session_number, values_from = present,
                      names_prefix = "session_", values_fill = 0)

session_cols <- setdiff(names(ids_wide), "id")
n_complete_both <- ids_wide %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(session_cols), ~ .x == 1)) %>%
  nrow()

print(n_ids_per_session)
print(avg_trials_per_session)
cat("\nIDs with data in both sessions:", n_complete_both,
    "/ total unique IDs:", dplyr::n_distinct(df$id), "\n")

## 3. Subject-level accuracy -> mean of subject means, SD
subject_accuracy <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, session_number) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_trials  = dplyr::n(),
    n_correct = sum(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    accuracy  = n_correct / n_trials
  )

chance_level <- 0.5  # adjust if chance isn't 50%

ttest_by_session <- subject_accuracy %>%
  dplyr::group_by(session_number) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ broom::tidy(t.test(.x$accuracy, mu = chance_level)))

print(ttest_by_session)

group_accuracy <- subject_accuracy %>%
  dplyr::group_by(session_number) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ids         = dplyr::n(),
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy),
    sd_accuracy   = sd(accuracy)
  )

print(group_accuracy)

## 4. GLMM: trial-level accuracy ~ session-
#  (1 + session_number | id) did not fit singular warning
m_2afc_cohort1 <- glmer(
  score ~ session_number + (1 | id),
  data = df,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

print(summary(m_2afc_cohort1))

or_ci <- exp(cbind(OR = fixef(m_2afc_cohort1),
                    confint(m_2afc_cohort1, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_")))
cat("Odds ratios (95% CI)"); print(or_ci)

0.56 (0.09)
0.55 (0.18)
```

## Cohort 1 SICR comparison
```{r}
## SICR: target sequence accuracy, session 1 vs 2, controlling
## for foil accuracy (Cohort 2)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(lmerTest)

## 1. Read data
sicr_path2 <- "cohort1_ssl_sicr_by_trial_s2.csv"

sicr2 <- read.csv(sicr_path2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    id              = as.factor(as.character(id)),
    session_number  = as.factor(as.character(session_number)),
    target_tag      = as.factor(as.character(target_tag))
  )


sicr <- sicr2

## Trial count checks: target vs. foil trials per id x session --
 
trial_counts <- sicr %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, session_number, target_tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_trials = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
 
cat("Trial counts by id x session x target_tag (first rows)")
print(head(trial_counts, 20))
 
trial_counts_summary <- trial_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(session_number, target_tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ids       = dplyr::n(),
    mean_trials = mean(n_trials),
    sd_trials   = sd(n_trials),
    min_trials  = min(n_trials),
    max_trials  = max(n_trials),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
cat("Trial count summary by session x target_tag (0 = foil, 1 = target)")
print(trial_counts_summary)

## Subject-level means, then mean of subject means, per measure,
##      separately for target and foil sequences
 
subject_means_by_tag <- sicr %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, session_number, target_tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_correct_serial_syllables = mean(correct_serial_syllables, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_correct_bigrams          = mean(correct_bigrams, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
 
group_means_by_tag <- subject_means_by_tag %>%
  dplyr::group_by(session_number, target_tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ids                    = dplyr::n(),
    mean_serial_syllables    = mean(mean_correct_serial_syllables),
    sd_serial_syllables      = sd(mean_correct_serial_syllables),
    mean_bigrams             = mean(mean_correct_bigrams),
    sd_bigrams               = sd(mean_correct_bigrams)
  )
 
cat("Mean (SD) of subject means, by session x target_tag (0 = foil, 1 = target)")
print(group_means_by_tag)

write.csv(group_means_by_tag, "cohort1_sicr_mean.csv", row.names = F)

## Models: all trials (target + foil), session x target_tag
##      interaction, random intercept for id
##      Interaction tests whether the session effect differs between
##      target and foil trials, rather than assuming a constant shift.
 
## Model 1: correct_serial_syllables ~ session * target_tag--
 
m_serial <- lmerTest::lmer(
  correct_serial_syllables ~ target_tag + (1 | id),
  data = sicr
)
cat("LMM: correct_serial_syllables ~ session * target_tag")
print(summary(m_serial))
 
## Model 2: correct_bigrams ~ session * target_tag
 
m_bigram <- lmerTest::lmer(
  correct_bigrams ~ target_tag + (1 | id),
  data = sicr
)
cat("LMM: correct_bigrams ~ session * target_tag")
print(summary(m_bigram))
```




## Cohort 2 SICR comparison
```{r}
## SICR: target sequence accuracy, session 1 vs 2, controlling
## for foil accuracy (Cohort 2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(lmerTest)

## 1. Read data
sicr_path1 <- "cohort2_ssl_sicr_by_trial_s1.csv"
sicr_path2 <- "cohort2_ssl_sicr_by_trial_s2.csv"

sicr1 <- read.csv(sicr_path1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    id              = as.factor(as.character(id)),
    session_number  = as.factor(as.character(session_number)),
    target_tag      = as.factor(as.character(target_tag))
  )

sicr2 <- read.csv(sicr_path2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    id              = as.factor(as.character(id)),
    session_number  = as.factor(as.character(session_number)),
    target_tag      = as.factor(as.character(target_tag))
  )

sicr <- dplyr::bind_rows(sicr1, sicr2)

## Trial count checks: target vs. foil trials per id x session --
 
trial_counts <- sicr %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, session_number, target_tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_trials = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
 
cat("Trial counts by id x session x target_tag (first rows)")
print(head(trial_counts, 20))
 
trial_counts_summary <- trial_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(session_number, target_tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ids       = dplyr::n(),
    mean_trials = mean(n_trials),
    sd_trials   = sd(n_trials),
    min_trials  = min(n_trials),
    max_trials  = max(n_trials),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
cat("Trial count summary by session x target_tag (0 = foil, 1 = target)")
print(trial_counts_summary)

## Subject-level means, then mean of subject means, per measure,
##      separately for target and foil sequences
 
subject_means_by_tag <- sicr %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, session_number, target_tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_correct_serial_syllables = mean(correct_serial_syllables, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_correct_bigrams          = mean(correct_bigrams, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
 
group_means_by_tag <- subject_means_by_tag %>%
  dplyr::group_by(session_number, target_tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ids                    = dplyr::n(),
    mean_serial_syllables    = mean(mean_correct_serial_syllables),
    sd_serial_syllables      = sd(mean_correct_serial_syllables),
    mean_bigrams             = mean(mean_correct_bigrams),
    sd_bigrams               = sd(mean_correct_bigrams)
  )
 
cat("Mean (SD) of subject means, by session x target_tag (0 = foil, 1 = target)")
print(group_means_by_tag)

write.csv(group_means_by_tag, "cohort2_sicr_mean.csv", row.names = F)

## Models: all trials (target + foil), session x target_tag
##      interaction, random intercept for id
##      Interaction tests whether the session effect differs between
##      target and foil trials, rather than assuming a constant shift.
 
## Model 1: correct_serial_syllables ~ session * target_tag--
 
m_serial <- lmerTest::lmer(
  correct_serial_syllables ~ session_number * target_tag + (1 + session_number | id),
  data = sicr
)
cat("LMM: correct_serial_syllables ~ session * target_tag")
print(summary(m_serial))
 
## target_tag difference within each session
emm_serial_tag <- emmeans(m_serial, ~ target_tag | session_number)
cat("emmeans: target vs. foil (correct_serial_syllables), within each session")
print(emm_serial_tag)
print(pairs(emm_serial_tag))
 
 
## Model 2: correct_bigrams ~ session * target_tag
 
m_bigram <- lmerTest::lmer(
  correct_bigrams ~ session_number * target_tag + (1 + session_number | id),
  data = sicr
)
cat("LMM: correct_bigrams ~ session * target_tag")
print(summary(m_bigram))
 
## target_tag difference within each session
emm_bigram_tag <- emmeans(m_bigram, ~ target_tag | session_number)
cat(" emmeans: target vs. foil (correct_bigrams), within each session")
print(emm_bigram_tag)
print(pairs(emm_bigram_tag))
```
